places.name: Presidio

future.spans_why: None: the bridges over water in the frame are the Golden Gate, kept whole as the map's landmark, and the Bay Bridge's west approach, whose spans lie past the east edge

wrecks.why: A freighter down in the channel south of Alcatraz
A ferry sunk off Pier 39 on its way to the island
A tug off Crissy Field, under the bridge's eye
